messages:
Alex: Heads up — planning to flip the response-normalizer_v3 flag in staging tonight. Target start 22:30 PST. Who can own the push + smoke checks?
Maria: I can take the push. Available 22:15–00:45 PST. Will run smoke and keep a live notes doc. @Kevin can you watch latency + errors?
Kevin: On it. I'll watch p50/p95/p99, 5xx rate, and token throughput. Set an alert if p50 > 120ms or 5xx spike > 0.5%.
Sylvia: Recommend safe defaults: keep safe_fallback=true for the first 30m and use a staged pct rollout (10 -> 50 -> 100). Also enable detailed tracing for the canary only.
Maria: Proposed plan: canary 10% at 22:30, hold 20m; if green -> 50% at 22:50, hold 25m; if green -> 100% at 23:20. Rollback path: flip flag off and pct=0.
Maria: Commands I'll run:
```
# enable 10% canary
rctl feature set response-normalizer_v3_enabled=true --env=staging
rctl feature set response-normalizer_v3_pct=10
```
Maria: Smoke checklist (short):
- run smoke_prompts.json against staging endpoint
- validate embeddings sample set (sanity checks)
- verify no decoder exceptions in logs
- check GPU mem and host OOMs
- confirm traces contain request_id and model variant

Raj: Dropped /tmp/smoke_prompts.json on staging host and shared sample outputs in drive. Maria use that.
Oncall-bot: NOTE: maintenance window 00:00–01:00 UTC tonight — avoid full 100% ramp into that window.
Alex: Good catch. Move timeline so 100% settles before maintenance. New target: start 22:15 PST so ramp completes by 23:45 PST. Maria ok?
Maria: Ack. I'll start 22:15 PST and post status updates here: started -> canary-ok -> ramp -> complete/rollback.
Kevin: If we see regressions, recommended immediate actions:
1) set safe_fallback=true
2) set response-normalizer_v3_pct=0
Commands:
```
rctl feature set response-normalizer_v3_enabled=false
rctl feature set response-normalizer_v3_pct=0
```
Sylvia: Hold criteria: any of the following during canary -> pause and investigate:
- >1% changed output variance vs baseline on sampled queries
- spike in 5xx or client error patterns
- sustained latency regression (p95 > baseline + 50ms)
Alex: Thanks team. Maria, ping here right before you flip and again after the 10% check. :thumbsup:
Maria: Will do. Starting notes and runbook linked in my dotfiles. I'll also attach the smoke logs to this thread as they come in.
